title: Isolated hypnotic regressions of the four Allagash witnesses

tellings.quote: we all four of us agreed to undergo um

plain: A man named Jim Weiner, one of four friends who say they were taken by a UFO on a 1976 camping trip in the Allagash wilderness, says all four of them agreed to be hypnotised, each on his own, in Massachusetts, to recover what they remembered. He tells it first-hand, and the sessions were run for the UFO investigator Raymond Fowler, who wrote them up in his book The Allagash Abductions.
